name: Las Vegas
summary: Use Las Vegas for an easy airport base, an evening on the Strip and carefully chosen desert day trips. It links well to Zion and the Grand Canyon, which deserve separate overnight bases.
seasonNote: Desert summer heat can be extreme; visit outdoor areas in cooler months and check trail closures.
arrival: LAS is close to the Strip; verify hotel pickup zones and resort fees before arrival.
gettingAround: Walk short Strip sections, use booked rides or transit, and rent a car for regional park travel.
cashTip: Cards are widely used; include tax, tips and resort/parking charges where relevant. Day budget excludes rental car and long excursions.
foodTip: Explore Chinatown for varied Asian food; do not assume a hotel buffet is the best-value meal.
buyTip: Use the Arts District for independent shops; compare outlet prices against actual normal prices.
baseArea: Central Strip for a brief first visit; quieter bases suit a driving trip.

items.name: Valley of Fire State Park
items.summary: Red sandstone scenery and short walks make a distinct state-park day.

items.tip: Official site lists an annual park closure December 1–14 and many trail closures May 15–September 30. Check current gate construction and access before driving.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate per private vehicle; state park is separate from federal passes.

items.tradeoffs: A driving excursion with severe summer heat and possible seasonal trail closures.

dayClusters.label: City districts, dinner and an evening on the Strip
dayClusters.note: Use the Arts District in daylight, travel to Chinatown for dinner, then see the fountains in the evening. These are spread-out districts: use booked rides and choose fewer stops if arriving late.

dayClusters.label: Red Rock Canyon day
dayClusters.note: Keep the scenic loop and selected trails together. Confirm the timed reservation and entry charge; choose a cool weather window and return to town before fatigue or heat becomes a problem.

dayClusters.label: Optional Hoover Dam excursion
dayClusters.note: The next choice for a third day if you want an engineering outing. Verify tour products, security rules and parking before leaving; use a flexible city day instead if you prefer a slower trip.

dayClusters.label: Alternative Valley of Fire day
dayClusters.note: An additional desert day or replacement for Hoover Dam. Check the annual December 1–14 park closure, summer trail closures and current gate construction; do not combine it with Red Rock as one hiking day.

dayClusters.label: Death Valley overnight extension
dayClusters.note: Prefer an overnight extension rather than adding another very long return day to a short Vegas visit. Check heat, roads, fuel and accommodation; the second day is the continuation/return, and costs beyond park entry remain additional.
